CHICAGO–(BUSINESS WIRE)– AArete, a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the appointment of Pam Shipley as chief executive officer. A Fortune 25 healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, Shipley succeeds AArete Founder Loren Trimble, who will transition from his role as CEO to board member.

highlights:
# AArete Names Pam Shipley CEO as Founder Loren Trimble Moves to Board

 August 12, 2026 

Pam Shipley 

AArete has appointed veteran healthcare executive Pam Shipley as chief executive officer, positioning the management and technology consulting firm for its next phase of growth following a strategic investment from Parthenon Capital.
...
Shipley succeeds AArete founder Loren Trimble, who is transitioning from CEO to a seat on the company’s board. Trimble founded AArete in 2008 and grew the business into a global consulting firm with more than 500 employees.

...
AArete, a Chicago-based management consultancy, has appointed Pam Shipley as chief executive officer.
...
Shipley, a Fortune 25 healthcare executive with 30+ years of experience, succeeds AArete founder Loren Trimble, who has led the consulting firm for 18 years. Trimble will remain at the firm as a board member.
